definitions.explanation: Having a rough or unrefined texture with large particles or loose weave.
Lacking precision or refinement in work or behavior.

examples.english: This cloth has a coarse weave.

examples.japanese: {粗|あら}い⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粗|あら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦やり{直|なお}して→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Your work is sloppy, so please redo it.
Coarse sand got into my shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粗|あら}い。
examples.english: He has a good personality, but his work is sloppy.

examples.japanese: {粗|あら}い⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦だいたい→だいたい：00831_daitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦わかる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Even with a rough calculation, you can get an approximate figure.

notes:
{粗|あら}い is an i-adjective describing coarseness of texture or crudeness of quality.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: ⟦{粗|あら}→粗：01917_ara⟧く
- Noun form: ⟦{粗|あら}→粗：01917_ara⟧さ (coarseness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粗|あら}い (coarse weave/mesh)
- {粗|あら}い⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (coarse salt)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{粗|あら}い (sloppy work)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {粗|あら}い vs. ⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧: Both read あらい, but {粗|あら}い refers to texture/quality (coarse, crude), while ⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧ refers to intensity/behavior (rough, wild, violent).

WRITING:
The distinction between ⟦{粗|あら}→粗：01917_ara⟧ and {荒|あら} is important but often confused in casual writing.
